_comment: Curated organizer ICS/RSS feeds for the bay ingest job. Deliberately empty:
every candidate checked this session (Stanford events calendar, Berkeley,
SF Station, SFPL) was either rate-limited, 404, or served HTML instead of a
feed. A checked-in feed is a promise the product makes to readers - that the
url is real, stable, and event-bearing - so entries are added only when a
feed has been verified by hand.
